animal_prompt: Production transparent isometric farming game animal animation sprite atlas. EXACT 4 EQUAL COLUMNS and 4 EQUAL ROWS, sixteen completely isolated full-body cutouts, generous transparent margins, no text, grid, ground base, shadows on backdrop or scenery. Same orthographic isometric camera facing lower-left in every cell, same size/ground-foot alignment across frames of each row. Match simple charming low-poly 3D rendered toy farming enclosures with warm soft lighting and smooth readable silhouettes. Row1 white chicken with red comb; row2 cream dairy cow with brown patches and pink muzzle; row3 pink pig; row4 cream goat with short horns. Column1 standing relaxed head raised, column2 head lowered grazing/pecking, column3 walking stride left feet forward, column4 walking stride right feet forward. Keep exact animal identity/proportions consistent across each row and every foot fully visible. Genuine transparent alpha, no checkerboard. Square canvas, each animal inside its own equal cell. No duplicate animals per cell.
